# openinfra_state_machine (Resource)

A workflow that orchestrates Functions in Amazon States Language (ASL) — open-infra's Step Functions. Run it by creating executions (from the console or kubectl, not Terraform, exactly as AWS starts executions from the API rather than Terraform).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `definition` (String) The workflow as an Amazon States Language (ASL) JSON document — the same string you would pass to `aws_sfn_state_machine.definition`. Use `jsonencode(...)` or a heredoc. Must have a top-level `StartAt` and `States`; Task states invoke a Function via `"Resource": "function:<name>"`.
- `name` (String) Resource name. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `namespace` (String) Kubernetes namespace. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `type` (String) Workflow class. One of: `Standard`. Only Standard (durable, checkpointed) is implemented; Express is planned.

### Read-Only

- `controller` (String) The controller running this state machine's executions.
- `id` (String) `namespace/name`, the import identifier.
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the resource's Ready condition is True. Terraform returns as soon as the object is accepted, so this is usually `false` immediately after apply — the platform reconciles asynchronously.
